description: This file defines the TreeGrain class, which implements a distributed tree structure as a grain in Orleans. It manages child grains and performs a ping operation asynchronously across its children.

classes.name: TreeGrain
classes.description: A grain class implementing a tree node in a distributed structure, capable of recursively delegating ping calls to its children.

methods.name: TreeGrain
methods.description: Constructor that initializes child grains based on its primary key and sets up the tree hierarchy.
